items.q: Why do some rivers form deltas and others form estuaries?
items.correct: Deltas form where rivers deposit sediment faster than the sea can remove it (calm seas, heavy load); estuaries form where tidal energy removes sediment (strong tides).
items.misconception: Deltas form on big rivers and estuaries on small ones.
items.random_wrong: Deltas form in cold climates and estuaries in warm climates.
items.why: Size doesn't determine the form. The balance of sediment supply vs marine energy does — the Nile (delta) and Thames (estuary) are similar size but in different sea conditions.

items.q: What type of coast features rock bands perpendicular to shoreline?
items.why: Correct answer: Discordant. “Concordant” sounds right because it borrows the language of the topic — but it fails this question. Re-read the notes on why.

items.q: Lulworth Cove is an example of which coast type?
items.why: Correct answer: Concordant. “Discordant” sounds right because it borrows the language of the topic — but it fails this question. Re-read the notes on why.

items.q: Approximately what is the annual cliff retreat rate at Happisburgh in metres?
items.why: The real figure is 6. The wrong options cluster deliberately close — anchor the exact number to one concrete fact so it can't drift.
